```python
from flask import Flask, make_response

app = Flask(__name__)


@app.route("/")
def hi():
    response = make_response("hi")
    response.status_code = 201
    response.headers["X-App"] = "demo"
    return response


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run()
```
